name: Ouji-sama no Propose Season 2
original_name: 王子様のプロポーズ シーズン2
source:
One day, you receive a mysterious invitation to attend a marriage interview with a prince. You don’t know how it’s possible, but it seems the prince has fallen in love with you at first sight!

Your very own Cinderella story starts now…

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.ouji2.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
有一天，你收到一份神秘邀请，要参加一位王子的婚姻面试。你不知道怎么可能，但王子似乎对你一见钟情！

你自己的灰姑娘故事现在开始……

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.ouji2.en]Google Play[/url]]
